findings.title: Public members endpoint changes response shape, breaking other consumers
findings.body: The `/groups/:name/members` response changed from a bare array to `{members, meta}`. Any other client that reads this endpoint as an array (plugins, or other JS such as the group members page and mention/autocomplete code) will break. Existing specs for GroupsController#members are not updated or added to cover the new shape. The previous behavior of returning all members for non-automatic groups is also gone.

findings.title: Unbounded, unvalidated limit/offset parameters
findings.body: `limit` and `offset` come straight from params with `.to_i` and no upper cap. A client can request an arbitrarily large limit and dump the whole group in one call. A negative limit or offset is passed to the query unchecked, which can raise a database error or give odd results.

findings.title: remove_member deletes via association with a raw id, skipping group bookkeeping
findings.body: `group.users.delete(user_id)` is passed an Integer, and has_many through delete expects records. It may delete the join row without the logic `Group#remove` provides. `add_members` uses `group.add`, so this is inconsistent. A nonexistent user_id is silently accepted. Using `User.find` and `group.remove(user)` would be safer.

findings.title: totalPages is off by one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit
findings.body: `Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1` gives 2 pages for exactly 50 users at limit 50. The UI shows a non-existent empty last page. `next` can then request an offset equal to user_count and return an empty list. Use Math.ceil.

findings.title: usernames not cleared after addMembers
findings.body: After adding members, the `usernames` input keeps its value (a TODO admits this). Clicking Add again resubmits the same names. The TODO is left unresolved.

findings.title: create no longer accepts the nested group params
findings.body: The create and update actions now read top-level params instead of `params[:group]`. The old nested format is silently ignored. Group visibility is also set from `params[:visible] == "true"`, so an omitted param resets visible to false on update.
